# s01 sample run transcripts (annotated)
#
# These are not byte-exact — LLM output is non-deterministic — they show the
# SHAPE of a successful run so a learner can tell "I ran it correctly" vs
# "something is broken".

## Run 1 — mock provider (offline, deterministic)

  $ go run . -provider mock -q "What did Eleanor patent in 1872?"

  [s01] ingested doc "testdata/book.txt" (provider=mock)
  === Answer ===
  [mock] retrieved 3 chunks (book::chunk-1, book::chunk-0, book::chunk-2)
  preview of top chunk: "Eleanor's most famous patent, granted in 1872, covered an improved theodolite ..."

  === References ===
  - book::chunk-1
  - book::chunk-0
  - book::chunk-2

  [mode=naive]

# What you should see
# - "ingested" line on stderr
# - "=== Answer ===" header on stdout
# - 3 References (top-K = 3)
# - mode line

## Run 2 — verbose mock (shows retrieval debug)

  $ go run . -provider mock -v -q "Where did Eleanor's papers end up?"

  [s01] ingested doc "testdata/book.txt" (provider=mock)
  [insert] doc=book chunks=5
  [query] q="Where did Eleanor's papers end up?" topK=3 retrieved=[book::chunk-4 book::chunk-2 book::chunk-3]
  === Answer ===
  [mock] retrieved 3 chunks (book::chunk-4, book::chunk-2, book::chunk-3)
  preview of top chunk: "Eleanor died in 1908. Her papers were donated to the Bramwell archive ..."

  === References ===
  - book::chunk-4
  - book::chunk-2
  - book::chunk-3

  [mode=naive]

## Run 3 — real OpenAI

  $ OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-... go run . -q "Why was the Tarvin Highlands trip cancelled?"

  [s01] ingested doc "testdata/book.txt" (provider=openai)
  === Answer ===
  The Tarvin Highlands expedition was cancelled because Scrooge's counting house
  caught fire, which Eleanor recorded in her diary as "a cold lesson in trusting
  wealthy patrons during the Christmas season" [book::chunk-3].

  === References ===
  - book::chunk-3
  - book::chunk-0
  - book::chunk-2

  [mode=naive]

# Notes
# - Real OpenAI answers are paraphrased and cite chunk IDs in [brackets].
# - Mock answers are deterministic — same query always returns the same Text.
# - Either way the References list is the source of truth for "what the LLM saw".
